headline: China and the African Union launch a joint mechanism for a 2026–2030 science partnership
summary: China’s Ministry of Science and Technology and the African Union Commission held their first joint science-and-technology cooperation committee meeting in Wuhan on Nov 11, 2026. China’s minister said the committee would jointly implement the China–Africa Science and Technology Partnership Plan Enhancement Action for 2026–2030, including joint research and technology demonstrations. A separate ministry notice from the same forum says it released a report on typical AI application scenarios for African countries. The inspected official notices establish an announced cooperation mechanism and report release, not project funding, AI-specific implementation or outcomes.
